verdict.rationale: Devin supports trigger-based autonomous work (Slack/Teams tags, PR review comments, CI/CD/static-analysis findings) and Auto-Fix creates a closed loop that iterates on CI failures without a human in the loop, and MCP exposes 'scheduling' as a session capability, all suggesting some always-on/triggered agent operation. However there's no dedicated docs for cron-like recurring schedules, and community reports describe sessions needing frequent human monitoring/termination rather than fully unattended long-running maintenance. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron configuration docs, independent evidence of reliable unattended multi-day maintenance loops, and confirmation that Auto-Fix/CI triggers work without human oversight in practice.
